verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS task and agent-orchestration platform like HumanLayer, but the evidence pack never documents any export function, bulk download, or open-format portability of tasks, sessions, comments or artifacts. Repository-level JSON workspace config and the option to run the stack on your own workstation are adjacent features, not a documented export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
